bio.zh: 在印度航线领了二十年航的老领航员,闭着眼也能数清好望角的浪。
bio.en: A chief pilot with twenty years on the India run, who counts the Cape's swells with his eyes shut.

bio.zh: 瓜达尔基维尔河口出身的老水手长,风暴里的甲板因他而井然有序。
bio.en: A boatswain raised by the Guadalquivir mouth, whose deck stays in order through any storm.

bio.zh: 在海峡追猎私掠船半生的炮长,信条是火药必须永远干燥。
bio.en: A gun captain who hunted privateers in the Channel for half a life; the powder stays dry, always.

bio.zh: 曾在帝国医馆坐堂的船医,坏血病在他船上从无踪迹。
bio.en: A ship surgeon once schooled in the imperial infirmary; scurvy never takes hold aboard his ship.

bio.zh: 联合省船坞里最好的修造师,他钉的每一根肋骨都严丝合缝。
bio.en: The finest shipwright out of the United Provinces' yards; every frame he sets sits flush.

bio.zh: 给威尼斯总督府做过宴的厨子,在咸风里也能端出像样的炖菜。
bio.en: A cook who once served the Doge's table, and still turns out a proper stew in the salt wind.

name.zh: 克里斯托瓦尔·德阿尔达纳

bio.zh: 在波多韦洛城墙下赢得佩剑的护航船长,剑与话一样快。
bio.en: A convoy captain who won his blade beneath the walls of Portobelo; his sword is as quick as his tongue.

bio.zh: 从印度航线水手一路升上来的船长,对每一名船员都记着名字。
bio.en: A captain risen from India-run deckhand to command, who keeps every crewman's name in his head.

bio.zh: 三次北上寻找东北航道的领航员,冰海与星图都是他的家园。
bio.en: The pilot who thrice sought the Northeast Passage; ice seas and star charts are home to him.

bio.zh: 金角湾炮台出的火炮长,齐射前必亲手量一遍装药。
bio.en: A gun master from the Golden Horn batteries who measures every charge himself before the salvo.

bio.zh: 塞维利亚外科行会出身的船医,缝合与配药从不假手他人。
bio.en: A ship surgeon out of the Seville surgeons' guild who trusts no other hands with suture or salve.

bio.zh: 修龙骨如同修钟表的匠人,船板在他手里从不浪费一根钉。
bio.en: A craftsman who trues a keel like a clockmaker; not one nail is wasted under his hands.

bio.zh: 嘴上不肯多话的厨子,锅里却总给水手多添一勺。
bio.en: A cook of few words who always slips the crew an extra ladleful.

bio.zh: 热那亚航海世家出来的领航员,地中海的每一股洋流他都画进过海图。
bio.en: A pilot from a Genoese seafaring house who has charted every current the Mediterranean owns.

bio.zh: 女王船队里出了名的铁面船长,追猎时从不需要第三种旗语。
bio.en: The Queen's iron-faced captain, famous for never needing a third signal flag in a chase.

bio.zh: 从桨帆船链凳上熬出来的水手长,吼声压得过浮桥的风。
bio.en: A boatswain who rose from a galley's bench, whose roar outlasts the wind off the bridge.

bio.zh: 威尼斯军械库里的射击教头,把每门炮都当有自己的脾气来伺候。
bio.en: A gunnery master out of the Venice arsenal who treats every cannon as if it had a temper of its own.

bio.zh: 药剂师出身的东方通,他写的风土志比宫廷的档案还要详尽。
bio.en: An apothecary turned hand on the eastern run, whose survey of the lands outdetails the court's own archives.

bio.zh: 跟着白银船队跑了半生的修造师,桅杆断了他也敢在海上接。
bio.en: A shipwright who half a life sailed with the silver fleets; he will fish a broken mast at sea if he must.

bio.zh: 一坛腌菜就能让全船在锚地重振士气的厨师。
bio.en: A cook whose one jar of pickles can raise a whole anchored crew's spirits.

bio.zh: 决斗从未输过的公司船长,教剑时嘴里永远衔着烟斗。
bio.en: The Company captain never beaten in a duel, who teaches swordplay with a pipe clenched in his teeth.

name.zh: 阿戈斯蒂诺·布里尼奥莱

bio.zh: 带着家族船队替共和国押运粮食的船长,从未误过一季。
bio.en: Captain of his house's grain convoys for the Republic, with never a season missed.

bio.zh: 北大西洋渔场里练出来的领航员,雾里认路靠的是水的味道。
bio.en: A pilot schooled in the North Atlantic fishing grounds who finds his way in fog by the taste of the water.

bio.zh: 水手们说他的哨音比船长的话更管用,他自己从不否认。
bio.en: The crew swears his whistle carries further than the captain's word, and he never denies it.

bio.zh: 自英格兰出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of England, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 荷兰港口里出了名的夜航好手,雾里也不迷向。
bio.en: The night-sailing toast of Holland's harbor, never lost even in fog.

bio.zh: 自意大利出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of Italy, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 自奥斯曼出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of Ottoman, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 自葡萄牙出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of Portugal, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 自西班牙出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of Spain, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 自英格兰出海的领航员,星图与洋流志从不离手。
bio.en: A pilot out of England, never far from star charts and current tables.

bio.zh: 在荷兰的船上学了十年观星,如今终于有了自己的海图桌。
bio.en: Ten years learning the stars aboard Holland ships, and a chart table finally his own.

bio.zh: 在英格兰的甲板上熬了半辈子,风暴天反而睡得更香。
bio.en: Half a life on England decks; he sleeps soundest in a storm.

bio.zh: 鞭子早就收起来了,可水手们还是不敢在他的甲板上偷懒。
bio.en: The rattan is long retired, yet none dawdle on his deck.

bio.zh: 鞭子早就收起来了,可水手们还是不敢在他的甲板上偷懒。
bio.en: The rattan is long retired, yet none dawdle on his deck.

bio.zh: 嗓门最大的水手长,缆索在他手里从不打错一个结。
bio.en: The loudest boatswain afloat; not one rope fouls under his knots.

bio.zh: 英格兰炮术行会的老会员,最恨受潮的火药。
bio.en: A senior of England's gunners' guild; nothing riles him like damp powder.

bio.zh: 打靶比打牌还在行的炮长,赌桌上却输多赢少。
bio.en: Better at targets than cards, and it shows at the betting table.

bio.zh: 意大利炮术行会的老会员,最恨受潮的火药。
bio.en: A senior of Italy's gunners' guild; nothing riles him like damp powder.

bio.zh: 装药永远亲手量的炮手,齐射前不看任何人脸色。
bio.en: A gunner who measures every charge himself and asks no one's leave before the salvo.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙炮术行会的老会员,最恨受潮的火药。
bio.en: A senior of Portugal's gunners' guild; nothing riles him like damp powder.

bio.zh: 药箱比钱包鼓的船医,治好过半条街的热病。
bio.en: A surgeon whose kit outweighs his purse, who has fevers of a whole street beaten.

bio.zh: 缝合利落、用药大胆的船医,水手们叫他最后一道保险。
bio.en: A deft, daring ship surgeon the crew calls the last line of safety.

bio.zh: 在意大利的医馆学徒出身,坏血病名单上从没有他的船。
bio.en: Trained in Italy's infirmary; no ship of his ever makes the scurvy lists.

bio.zh: 缝合利落、用药大胆的船医,水手们叫他最后一道保险。

bio.zh: 海上一面补帆一面补船板的巧手,脾气好得出奇。
bio.en: Deft hands that patch sail and plank together at sea, and a temper sweet as honey.

bio.zh: 修龙骨像修钟表的匠人,一根钉也不肯多用。
bio.en: A craftsman who trues a keel like a clockmaker and wastes not one nail.

bio.en: Trained in Spain's taverns; fresh water or salt wind, nothing spoils his pot.

bio.zh: 咸牛肉也能做出花样的厨师,锅里永远有下一勺。
bio.en: A cook who makes salt beef a delicacy; the pot always has one more ladle.

bio.zh: 带过三条船的老船长,决斗场上从未输过。
bio.en: An old captain of three hulls, never once beaten in the dueling yard.

bio.zh: 带过三条船的老船长,决斗场上从未输过。
bio.en: An old captain of three hulls, never once beaten in the dueling yard.

bio.zh: 从桅顶瞭望一路升上来的船长,眼力比望远镜还利。
bio.en: A captain who climbed up from the masthead, with eyes sharper than any glass.

bio.zh: 商人出身的船长,更信算术胜过火药。
bio.en: A captain out of the countinghouse who trusts arithmetic over powder.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙海军里退役的船长,令行禁止,赏罚分明。
bio.en: A captain retired from Portugal's navy; orders kept, rewards exact.

bio.zh: 一位在老领航员手下学艺的青年,星象与海图无一不精。
bio.en: A young pilot schooled by old navigators; at home with stars and charts alike.

bio.zh: 在塞维利亚船坞里长大的老水手长,一声令下缆索便各归其位。
bio.en: A boatswain raised in the Seville yards, whose whistle sends every rope to its place.

bio.zh: 曾在英吉利海峡追捕私掠者的炮手,最看重火药干燥与否。
bio.en: A gunner who once chased privateers in the Channel, and cares above all that the powder stays dry.

bio.zh: 弗里斯兰出身的水手长,能在暴风里把甲板收拾得井井有条。
bio.en: A Frisian boatswain who can keep a deck in order even through a gale.

bio.zh: 在金角湾炮台服役多年的老炮长,开火前总要亲手校一遍炮位。
bio.en: A veteran gun captain from the Golden Horn batteries, who sights each gun himself before firing.

bio.zh: 为威尼斯商船绘制海图的领航员,对亚得里亚海的每一处暗礁都了然于心。
bio.en: A chart-maker for Venetian merchantmen, who knows every reef in the Adriatic by heart.
